title: Impulse from Force-Time Graph
body: A net force acts on a 2 kg object initially at rest. The force varies with time as follows: 0-2 s: Force = 10 N; 2-4 s: Force = 5 N. Calculate: (a) the total impulse delivered to the object over the 4 seconds, and (b) the final velocity of the object.
oer: Siyavula Physical Sciences Grade 12 - Momentum and Impulse
